items.text: Kotema EJAKAIT Musa atiar, “Koloma mama ejai Parao, kolimok ŋes ebe, ‘lnera EJAKAIT, Edeke loka Iburanian, kwanata ebe, “Kisiik ikatuŋa alosit, tetere kejaanakinete eoŋ,
Naarai arai kiner aisiikin kes alosit, kigirunio kes bobo,
Koany, ejai akan naka EJAKAIT obarcnekon luejaas orony, obalasin, ka asigirian, ka akaalai, osipanin da luka aituk ka luka amerekekin: ejaun cmelekede loepol noi.
Etiakari EJAKAIT ibaren luka Isirael kobaren luka Misiri: emamei yenetwani koboro kere lueraas luka idwe luka lsirael.”
Koseu EJAKAIT apak kobala ebe, “Iswamai moi EJAKAIT akirot ŋin kakwap.”
Kiswama EJAKAIT akirot ŋin tupuruc, kotwaka ibaren kere luko Misiri: konye emamei yenabu kotwana kobaren luka idwe luka lsirael.
Abu Parao kijuka, ido koany, komamei idioda yenatwanit kobaren luka lsiraelin. Konye koninikiar etau loka Parao, mam abu kisiik ituŋa alosit.
Kotema EJAKAIT Musa ka Aaron atiar, “Komukutu ekurwon koupa aileleb akusikanin, kosodi Musa aiwelar kuju kakonyen nuka Parao.
Eraun apua kakwap kere nako Misiri, edekakinos ituŋa ka itian abusion nuebulonoros araun ajimii, anatar akwap kere nako Misiri.”
Komukut ekurwon koupa, kobwaata kakonyen nuka Parao; kiwela Musa ekurwon kuju; koraun adek naka abusion nuebulonoros araun ajimii kotuna ka itian da.
Kokurwokis imurwok aibwo kakonyen nuka Musa kanuka abusion: naarai adekas imurwok da abusi on, ka lmisirian kere.
Kitogogon EJAKAIT etau loka Parao, mam abu kiira kes; kwape abalar EJAKAIT Musa.
Kotema EJAKAIT Musa atiar, “Kodil tupuruc sek kobwo kakonyen nuka Parao, kolimok ŋes ebe, ‘Inera EJAKAIT, Edeke loka lburanian, kwanata ebe, “Kisiik ikatuŋa alosit, tetere kejaanakinete eoŋ.
Naarai irwan na ejukuni akatular kere otaukon, neeiaas ikonikejaanakinak kotunakon da; tetere ijenuni ebe emamei yenikiputor eoŋ kakwap kere,
Naarai tiariorit akakan, aidany jo ka ikonituŋa katular, ti jo kimudiar kakwap:
Konye abeit kanuka akirot kana, ŋes ketajaria eoŋ jo, tetere ketodikini jo akapedor, kosodi ekakiror alimorio kakwap kere.
Aitodol kwana da ituro kereka ijo kotuŋaka ebe, mam isiikini kes alosit?
Koany, moi kapak kana, etetcpi akako naededen noi, namam apeŋo ejauna Misiri ageun kapaaran naasubunere aitodol lolo.
Aso do kijuka, kisunya aitolomun ibarenekon ka lukon kere luijaas orony; naarai ninitunanan ka ŋolitiaŋ loedumakinio orony, mam eyaunitai ore, elei kes akako, etwakete.”
Ŋin yen abu koyon akirot naka EJAKAIT kokejaanakinak luka Parao abu kitoloma ikekejaanakinak ka ibareneke otogoi.
Konye yenimam abu kopodokin akirot naka EJAKAIT abu kinyeik ikekejaanakinak ka ibareneke korony.
Kotema EJAKAIT Musa atiar, “Korio akonikan akuj, tetere etepi akako akwap kere nako Misiri, ituŋa ka itian, ka ninikiot yenika emanikor, kakwap kere nako Misiri.”
Kosodi Musa arior ekebela akuj: kijuk EJAKAIT eires ka akako, kijesun akim akwap; kitetep EJAKAIT akako akwap nako Misiri.
Kojaun akako, kinyalakina akim kakako, kopol noi, namam apeŋo ejauna akwap nako Misiri kere ageun naaraunor ateker.
Konata akaka akwap nako Misiri elei ŋinibore kere yenajai orony, ituŋa ka itiaŋ da; kole akaka nclikiot lokorony, kobilibil ŋolikiroi lokorony.
Dimarai akwap nako Gosen bon, naajaas idwe luka Isirael, ŋes amamei akako.
Abu Parao kiyakia anyaraun Musa ka Aaron, kotema kes atiar, “Adiaka con irwan na: edolit EJAKAIT, konye eoŋ ka ikatuŋa kiroko.
Kilipa EJAKAIT: naarai apoloor eires ka akako, kesiikini eoŋ da yes alosit, mam bobo isalete.”
Kotcma Musa ŋes atiar, “Kadau eoŋ alomar kore, ariori akakanin atipet mama ejai EJAKAIT: enaŋi eires, emameun bobo akako, tetere ijenuni ebe EJAKAIT ŋes elopet akwap.
Konye ijo ka ikonikejaanakinak, ajeni ebe mam iyonete EJAKAIT Edeke.”
naarai asuri esairi epolimaete da abira.
Koloma Musa kaneajai Parao, kina naka ere, korio akekanin mama ejai EJAKAIT: konan eires ka akako, mam akiru abu kotep akwap.
Keanyu Parao ebe anaŋ akiru ka akaka ka eires, kodiaka bobo, kitininik eketau, ŋes ka ikekejaanakinako
Kogogonior etau loka Parao, mam abu kisiik idwe luka Isirael alosit: kwape abalar EJAKAIT Musa.
